entities.name: PMID:25424393
observations: In adult ssTnI/TNNI1-transgenic mice subjected to transverse aortic constriction for 12–13 weeks, ssTnI limited pressure-overload remodeling and preserved cardiac function.

ssTnI pressure-overload hearts increased glucose oxidation, reduced palmitate oxidation and anaplerosis, and reduced PDK4 expression; these changes accompanied preservation of energy charge and function.
The study supports improved metabolic efficiency as a mediator of protection, but did not independently manipulate PDK4 or substrate oxidation.

entities.name: TNNI1
observations: Slow skeletal troponin I (ssTnI) expression in adult mouse hearts was associated with protection from TAC-induced remodeling and dysfunction and with a more efficient myocardial substrate-oxidation profile.

entities.name: ssTnI metabolic protection
observations: In TAC hearts, ssTnI was associated with increased glucose oxidation, reduced palmitate oxidation and anaplerosis, reduced PDK4 expression, preserved phosphocreatine:ATP, and protection from hypertrophy and diastolic dysfunction.
The metabolic pathway was not independently perturbed, so necessity and sufficiency of metabolic efficiency remain unproven.

entities.name: Postpartum hemorrhage
observations: Primary postpartum hemorrhage with persistent bleeding and a soft, boggy uterus is most consistent with uterine atony after placental delivery and exclusion of genital tract laceration.
Guideline sequencing supports a second-line uterotonic before balloon tamponade or invasive procedures in a hemodynamically stable patient.

entities.name: Methylergonovine
observations: Standard second-line uterotonic after oxytocin, but contraindicated in hypertension because vasoconstriction can cause severe blood-pressure elevation.

entities.name: Carboprost tromethamine
observations: Second-line uterotonic option, but generally avoided in asthma because bronchoconstriction or bronchospasm may occur.

entities.name: Misoprostol
observations: Alternative uterotonic when methylergonovine and carboprost are contraindicated or unavailable; appropriate in this case because of hypertension and asthma.

entities.name: Intrauterine balloon tamponade
observations: Recommended escalation for persistent atony after appropriate uterotonics in a stable patient, before embolization, compression sutures, or hysterectomy.
